quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: 2025 revenue RMB 1,257,525,262.45, up 41.13%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 103,086,531.28, up 10.90%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 235,925,674.16, Q2 RMB 268,230,588.75, Q3 RMB 342,460,122.64, Q4 RMB 410,908,876.90; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 21,290,668.08. 400G-and-above modules RMB 689,245,621.07 (+80.46%, 54.81% of revenue, gross margin 37.03%); below-400G modules RMB 537,834,576.52 (+7.49%, gross margin 30.36%). Overseas revenue RMB 1,120,346,365.89 (+41.16%), 89.09% of revenue; overall gross margin 34.13%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: optical modules (including contract-processed modules) had 2025 capacity of 418 ten-thousand units, output 302 and sales 286 ten-thousand units (2024: 427 / 251 / 246 ten-thousand), revenue RMB 1,238,669,249.10 at a 34.00% gross margin, with high-speed products a rising share. Phases 1 and 2 of the Malaysia (Penang) capacity are fully in operation and phase 3 is being prepared; the Malaysia manufacturing base project is 100% complete (cumulative investment RMB 108,961,523.21) and the Malaysian subsidiary earned RMB 733,216,063.10. 400G-and-above modules sold overseas: 27 ten-thousand units for RMB 633,050,718.24. Inventory rose to RMB 961,677,060.75 (start of year RMB 539,714,655.10) and operating cash flow was RMB -206,196,445.26, mainly from paying for stockpiled materials.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity 418 / output 302 / sales 286 ten-thousand units; 400G+ overseas 27 ten-thousand units

quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D investment RMB 102,229,429.71 (8.13% of revenue; up 41.49%). 1.6T FRO, LRO and LPO projects on 200G per lane: some have moved from prototype to small-batch trial production and products are with multiple customers for testing and validation; 800G / 400G products on 100G per lane are in volume production; early development of 3.2T and 400G-per-lane modules has started, and it launched 12.8T liquid-cooled XPO. Project status at year-end: 1.6T series (2DR4/2FR4 FRO, LRO, LPO) 70%; fourth-generation 800G (silicon-photonics 2xDR4 and 2xFR4 LPO, 5nm low-power DSP platform) 80%.

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report business plan: the company plans to keep expanding capacity, investing in production facilities and lines and further expanding its Malaysian capacity; to deepen strategic cooperation with hyperscale cloud providers and AI data-center operators, especially in North America; and to develop silicon photonics, TFLN, LPO/LRO and CPO, optimise 800G modules and work on 1.6T, 3.2T and 400G-per-lane products.
